newsitem.title: INDIA: Army officer accused in Kashmir activist's death.
newsitem.headline: Army officer accused in Kashmir activist's death.

text.p: Indian police have accused an army officer of involvement in last year's death of a leading human rights activist in Kashmir, according to court documents. The Srinagar High Court said in an order obtained by Reuters that a special police investigation team headed by S.K. Mishra suspected an army major of involvement in the killing of prominent lawyer and human rights activist Jalil Andrabi.
Andrabi's body was discovered on March 27, 1996, in the Jhelum River in Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir state.
The chairman of the Kashmir Commission of Jurists, Andrabi had been abducted two weeks earlier by unidentified gunmen as he was driving home with his family.
His wife said at the time that Indian security forces had picked him up, but the army denied the charge.

"From the reports filed by Mr Mishra from time to time ... it is apparent that they have been able to identify the accused involved in the death of Mr Jalil Andrabi," a two-judge division bench of Srinagar High Court said in its order dated April 10.
The order said one of the suspects was a major in the Indian army at the time of the killing.
The high court ordered the formation of the special investigation team two weeks before Andrabi's decomposed body was found.
The army said the accused had been a member of the territorial army, made up of volunteers who serve for six months to a year in army units.
"The accused was a territorial army officer and did not commit the crime in his official capacity," an army official told Reuters in Srinagar on Friday.

The court order said the federal government had told the two-judge bench that the accused army officer had been relieved of his duties last November 7. But the order said the bar association had expressed doubts that the accused had left the army.
Police and hospital officials say more than 20,000 people have died in insurgency-related violence since a separatist revolt erupted in 1990.
Andrabi's killing sparked international condemnation and calls for a full investigation.
